latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editor Highlights 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches automated video highlight extraction and compilation for sports creators, YouTubers, and event videographers.
- Upload raw video (up to 500MB); describe your goal (e.g., "make a 90-second highlight reel") and get back a 1080p MP4.
- Integrated cloud rendering pipeline—no manual editing or local install required.
- Supports session management, credits, export, and error handling with clear user feedback.
- Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and common image/audio formats for input.
